title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
slides: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could.

thread_text:
1. Meta's AI pet vs mine

Last year Meta filed patents for AI pets. I built one that runs on a $5 chip.

2. The $5 chip secret

While Meta's version likely needs cloud servers, mine fits in your pocket and costs less than lunch.

3. Why open source wins

I published the code. Anyone can clone it today without asking a giant for permission.

4. The giant's blind spot

Meta won't ship a toy that costs $5. That's exactly why indie builders should.

5. Ship before they notice

Go grab the open-source repo and build your own weird AI pet this weekend.
